title: Good morning
subtitle: Beta access ended on 25 Nov 2026.
headline: Your beta access ended on 25 Nov 2026
body: Thank you for testing Sidekick. To keep using it, ask the person who invited you to the beta for a new token and enter it below. Nothing has been deleted: your Activity, your settings and the files you received are all still here, and Activity can still be exported.
toasts: Your Sidekick beta access ends within a day, on 25 Nov 2026. A new token can be entered in Settings › About.
